script_text: The cosmos flips your financial script this week, Taurus. Monday opens with Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 2nd House of resources, sparking a idea, while Venus squares Saturn from the 2nd to the 12th House, triggering money tension. Tuesday the Venus-Saturn square peaks, testing your Earth-sign patience in love and budget. Wednesday Venus enters Cancer, landing in your 3rd House of communication, and trines Pluto in your 10th House, turning conversations into career breakthroughs. Thursday through Sunday Mars in Cancer squares Saturn, stirring home energy, yet the Sun in Gemini illuminates your 2nd House, favoring negotiations. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 3rd House and trines Pluto, boosting romance talks and professional visibility. Tuesday is your challenge day as Venus squares Saturn, creating financial friction and emotional distance. Channel the Venus-Pluto trine by initiating a talk about finances. Follow for daily updates.
